entities.summary: Naglaa Fathi, whose birth name is Fatmah Elzahra' Hesin Fathi, is an Egyptian actress. She started her acting career in 1967 and has played a role in over 80 films. She established a production company and produced films, including film : Supermarket (1990) in which she was actress also. The award-winning actress also wrote the screenplay for Tomorrow I Will Take Revenge, (1980).
